name: Compact
author: Freek van Gool
description: A compact layout for small screens: rotary knobs with the label underneath, the slice pads and the pattern steps in two rows of eight and the settings grouped in one frame, at roughly half the width and half the height of the standard card.

appearances.name: Compact
appearances.description: Rotary knobs in grouped frames, tighter pads and rows, much smaller than the standard card.
